newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts Australia mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts Australia mortgage rate.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Monday it had reduced its standard variable home loan rate to 7.55 percent from 8.25 percent.
For new loans, the new rate takes effect on February 18. For existing loans, it takes effect from April 7.
ANZ said it had also cut its ANZ Money Saver Home Loan rate to 6.90 percent from 6.95 percent, effective for new loans from February 18 and existing loans from April 7.

ANZ Chief General Manager, Australian retail division, Peter Hawkins said in a statement that ANZ was developing a premium home loan package for release later in 1997 that would offer customers an extended range of benefits, and would include a monthly account service fee.
ANZ's rate reduction brings its rates in line with the Commonwealth Bank of Australia and National Australia Bank Ltd which last week cut their rates in the highly-competitive home lending market.
Westpac Banking Corp is the only one of the 'big four' Australian banks not to cut its mortgage rate in the latest round of cuts, which Commonwealth Bank instigated last week.
